name: create_workspace
description: Create one persistent workspace for isolated work. Give it a short title written the way a person would write it, such as "Retry policy rewrite": Happy Agent builds the Git branch and the folder from that title, so write a title rather than a slug or a path. The workspace comes back while its checkout and setup may still be running; the result includes complete branch, path, base, status, and ownership detail, and you can follow its detail cursor with get_workspace when the model-output budget requires another page.
